name: zopt_read_scalar_value_as_int
description: zOpt::ReadScalarValueAsInt converts zReader scalar nodes to integer values using inline int payloads, float conversion, named-token lookup, or 0 for unsupported node kinds.
known_limits: Binary Ninja keeps a limited reconstruction marker because the zReader node union still renders all payload reads through the first union member name. The smoke verifies int, float, string-token, and unsupported node-kind behavior.
